title: MultiContrievers: Analysis of Dense Retrieval Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring allocational fairness as the difference in retrieval performance (e.g., NDCG@10) between queries about male versus female entities using a custom annotated subset of Natural Questions (NQ-gender). The paper also uses information-theoretic probing (Minimum Description Length) to measure gender extractability and Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP) to perform a causal analysis by removing gender from the model's representations to see if the performance disparity persists.
